exposure: Mode of delivery (Caesarean section vs vaginal delivery)
Type of caesarean section (Elective vs Emergency)
cohort: 750 neonates born in a tertiary care hospital in a developing country.
finding: Neonates delivered via emergency caesarean section had a significantly higher rate of neonatal morbidity and mortality compared to those delivered via elective caesarean section.
mod_finding: Emergency caesarean section was independently associated with increased odds of NICU admission (adjusted OR 13.35, 95% CI 1.69-105.38, p=0.014) and neonatal mortality.
